description: Show what a watched publisher lists now, as Minos last observed it: RSK resources and files, BAW NFZ orders and attachments, or NFZ dictionaries and notices, with versions and dates. Reads Minos's last snapshot and never calls the publisher. Compare with get_service_info to see whether Minos serves the newest release.

source.description: rsk: RSK resources; baw: NFZ orders; nfz: NFZ dictionaries and notices.

name: get_source_status
title: Source status
